The '''Standard Operations Procedure''' dictated the operational workings of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It stated that mounted [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] should be deployed in teams of two in case of unforeseen danger.
